ENTITLED:“AN ORDINANCE CREATING SECTION13.04.141, FEE ASSESSMENT
ON GROSS REVENUES, OF CHAPTER 13.04, BOARD OF PUBLIC
UTILITIES, OF TITLE 13, PUBLIC UTILITIES GENERALLY, OF THE
CODE OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE, WYOMING."
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE,
WYOMING:
Section 1. That Section 13.04.141, Fee assessment on gross revenues, of Chapter 13.04,
Board of Public Utilities, of Title 13, Public Utilities Generally, of the Code of the City of
Cheyenne, Wyoming, is hereby created as set out in this ordinance.
13.04.141
Fee assessment ongross revenues.
Effective July 1, 2021 and continuing thereafter, the board shall assess a two percent (2%)
fee on gross revenues of water and sewage services and remit those fees to the city treasurer as a
pass through.
Section 2.
That this ordinance shall be in full force and effect on July 1, 2021.
